blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Vice Mayor Tomas Osmeña said he will file an Ombudsman case over the planned purchase of property along F. Vestil Street in Barangay Mambaling for the Cebu Bus Rapid Transit (CBRT) project, questioning its reported P80,000-per-square-meter price and roughly P200 million cost. The announcement came during the council’s regular session on September 29, as the body took up a City Legal Office recommendation to hold in abeyance the processing of payments for CBRT-affected properties along F. Vestil Street pending guidance from the Department of Transportation (DOTr). The council ultimately adopted the recommendation, directing the CBRT Project Management […]...
